recommendations.assessment: Best tested candidate for both words; source outlines are visibly polygonized and some local stroke differences remain. Not exact font identification.
Consistent best tested candidate for two independent phrases. Rounded Gulim corners correspond to polygonized source corners; not proof of exact original font.
Closest among tested candidates for this numeral, but Gulim regular is close too. A single numeral does not establish a distinct font family from VIEW/DETAIL.

Alternative approximate candidates for the same note style. Whole-word results favor regular for FRNT_MAIN and bold for CS PAD, but FRNT and MAIN subword tests change the ranking. Do not call these two independently established source font styles.

Outlined Arial Italic is the closest tested general font, but the source K joint and proportions differ substantially. Preserve only observed K/E/T as a logo-like partial style; do not generalize this evidence into a verified 62-character source font.
No sufficiently close candidate found. Source stems/arches differ from all tested fonts. Candidate rank alone is not enough to select a source font.

observed_additions.not_included: COVER individual glyphs were not extracted because projection bands overlap; full original word remains as evidence. The upright digit 1 beside KET is not merged into its oblique logo style.

limits: The source word and installed candidate use one global width factor and one common tracking value per word; glyph geometry is not independently warped.
Scores are raster shape distances normalized by ink height, not accuracy percentages or probabilities.
Filled/outline/stroke rendering must remain distinct in dataset generation.
Windows font collection face indices and hashes are recorded. Font binaries are not included in the evidence package.
